name: Volcanic Vent · Cold
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 4-block radius for 9 s. Every second, on everyone inside except you:
• Damage 4.5 ❤ fire + 2.25 ❤ earth + 2.25 ❤ arcane (fire ×0.5 on wet, earth ×2 on frozen)
• Heat: sets on fire for 21.6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Knockback
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 6.75 s
• Launches upward
• Cold 80: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Slowness III for 9 s
